about.headline: More Than Games. More Than Gifts. Stories That Bring People Together.
about.description: At <bold>My Travel Games</bold>, we believe that the most meaningful memories are created when people connect, explore, and share experiences together. What began as a passion for travel and discovering new cultures grew into a mission: to create products that inspire curiosity, spark conversations, and bring people closer to one another. Every game and every gift in our collection is carefully selected to celebrate the joy of discovery and the stories that make each journey unique. We see travel as more than visiting new places. It is about understanding cultures, creating connections, and collecting moments that stay with us long after the journey ends. Our products are designed with that same spirit—to turn simple moments into lasting memories. Whether you are searching for a meaningful gift, a unique travel-inspired game, or a way to share unforgettable experiences with family and friends, you are part of a community that values adventure, learning, and human connection. <emphasis>Because the best souvenirs are not the things we bring home—they are the memories, stories, and friendships we create along the way.</emphasis>
about.cta: <cta>Create memories. Discover the world. Share the journey.</cta>

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are?
whoWeAre.description:
MyTravelGames creates compact, practical and distinctive games and travel products designed to make journeys more enjoyable.Our story began with a simple idea: travel time should be part of the experience, not just the time between two destinations.
We develop travel-friendly games, wooden game pieces, family products, souvenirs and personalized items for children and adults.
Our products are designed for use on flights, train journeys, road trips, holidays, hotels, beaches and other moments away from home.We focus on a combination of practical design, accessible pricing, quality materials and original ideas.
Many of our wooden components are made from beech wood, while fabric-based products are created to be lightweight, compact and easy to carry.
MyTravelGames also works with hotels, airlines, travel companies, retailers, distributors and corporate partners, offering products for retail, promotional campaigns, guest gifts and customized projects.From a small family game to a personalized travel gift, our goal is the same: to create products that bring people together and turn ordinary travel moments into lasting memories.
Designed for travel.
Made for shared moments.
